brief:
Hi! We just opened our little café, Bean & Bloom, and want a 30-second Instagram reel from today's grand opening.
It should feel warm, cosy and energetic. Start outside so people see where we are, then show our coffee being made —
especially the latte art, our barista is amazing at it. Show happy customers, a slow look at our pastries,
and me welcoming everyone (please use the bit where I actually say welcome!). We also did a ribbon cutting at the door.
End with everyone raising a toast. Nothing blurry or too dark, please — we want it to look professional.
